# To accurately document failed building accessibility checks, employees should follow these checklists:

1. Understand the Building Accessibility Checklist.
2. Be aware of and be able to identify any observable violations or non-conformities.
3. Keep records (such as pictures and other documents) of inspections conducted.
4. Document building violations and hazards.
5. Follow the company's internal processes and procedures.
6. Report all building violations to the building manager.
7. Communicate with the team leader to discuss and review building violations.
8. Keep up with any relevant legislation or guidance related to building accessibility.
9. Follow on to review the checklist when necessary.
10. Continue
